name: j-skills
description: Global, cross-repo agent skills: capture durable session learnings (memory.remember), periodically compact MEMORY.md (memory.compact), run a personal five-phase dev workflow (workflow), run a read-first workspace health check (checkup), grade candidate models against eval golden sets (evals), run a session retrospective that proposes environment fixes (retro), write a cited, human-friendly HTML explainer for a finished run or a codebase area (understand), explain things or rewrite text in plain English (plain), and write documents agents read (agent-docs).
